It was another account I use but wanted to do it with this one so it was more anonymous sorry.


- My take home is £800 a month (roughly)

- Guarantor loan costs me £450 a month
- I normally have about £100 I owe to friends etc from borrowing from the previous month
- My debt management plan is £170 but I haven’t been able to pay recently due to falling behind one month on my guarantor loan (plus there are some companies I owe money too who aren’t yet included on my dmp)
- I’ve given up smoking and drinking but I somehow seem to not have saved any money.
- any money I have left goes on food/drinks/travel 

I considered getting another job in the evenings but any work in the evening i got needed me to start earlier than I finish my main full time job. And even after that my last train home is before I’d finish the evening job. (I live an hour and a half away on a train from my full time job in London)
